rows.label: qst703301_msg0002
rows.name:
Tarath! Didn't expect
to find you here!

rows.label: qst703301_msg0003
rows.name: What happened to guarding the garden?

rows.label: qst703301_msg0004
rows.name:
I got hurt in the attack the other
day... My legs still aren't moving
properly.

rows.label: qst703301_msg0005
rows.name:
So they reassigned me to guard
Iira's Womb for now.

rows.label: qst703301_msg0007
rows.name:
Are you okay? You're saying it so
casually, but that sounds serious...

rows.label: qst703301_msg0008
rows.name:
Don't look so serious! It'll heal
properly, and it hasn't all been bad.

rows.label: qst703301_msg0009
rows.name:
I've started chatting with
Seiryuu-sama sometimes. He tells me
all sorts of war stories!

rows.label: qst703301_msg0011
rows.name:
Yes! He has lived 800 years, after
all. Everything he does is on such
a huge scale.

rows.label: qst703301_msg0012
rows.name:
Like the story the other day about
lavishing a huge sum of money...

rows.label: qst703301_msg0014
rows.name:
Oh, er, well, um...
*Cough cough cough*

rows.label: qst703301_msg0015
rows.name:
That reminds me! Seiryuu-sama asked me
to tell you all to come see him.

rows.label: qst703301_msg0017
rows.name:
I'll return to my post after I rest
my legs a little longer.
